pages.text: Down is not dead: a friend revives you where you fell. Alone, you wait it out.$(br)A $(bold)bandage$(), held to use, stops the bleeding, sets a limb and closes two hearts.$(br)A $(bold)med kit$() does the same, closes six, and $(bold)cures a bite$(). Nothing else does. Tony's card makes them; the parts are where medicine was kept.
